budskap: Doktoravhandling om British Columbia: tilsyn med bøter kan redusere skader, tilsyn uten bøter ikke; i British Columbia, der bøter er sjeldne, påvirker tilsyn generelt ikke akutte skader.
id_sitat: It was found that inspections generally do not influence acute injuries, which supports the hypothesis that inspections at WorkSafeBC, where penalties are rare, will not be effective at decreasing injuries.
